sampling: independent codex exec --ephemeral invocations; no seed claim; retry transport/schema failure up to 2 times without changing prompt

B13.definition: A reference-aware whole-recipe transformation mechanism: the implementation builds or preserves ingredient identity/index links to dependent instruction/equipment fields and applies substitutions as ordered global rewrite passes, rather than handling each output field independently. Ingredient IDs required only as inert input keys do not count.
B13.source_relation: Orchestral instrument-part substitutions update every linked cue, range, seating need, and balance instruction, with prioritized replacements and post-step constraint checks.
required_code_evidence: an explicit reference/index/link from ingredient identity to dependent recipe fields or a semantic intermediate representation
a global or ordered rewrite operation that propagates a substitution across more than the ingredient row

C03.definition: A uniform recursive content-node mechanism: atomic items and nested groups participate in the same traversal/operation protocol, so word count, unresolved markers, or outline rendering recurse through one shared abstraction. Merely writing separate ad-hoc recursive functions over dictionaries does not count.
C03.source_relation: The freight desk handles a parcel and a crate through the same weighing, label-collection, and manifest procedures, recursively for nested crates.
required_code_evidence: a shared node/item protocol, base class, or uniform dispatcher covering both leaves and groups
at least two required operations delegated recursively through that same abstraction

C20.definition: A triadic model/view/action-interpreter mechanism: authoritative session state, deterministic screen construction, and action interpretation are distinct collaborating components with injected input/output ports. Helper functions inside one monolithic console class do not count.
C20.source_relation: The restaurant keeps an authoritative kitchen slate, uses a separate plating station for presentation, and a server to interpret guest requests, with replaceable ordering/delivery channels.
required_code_evidence: a distinct action interpreter/controller that coordinates them
input and output ports are replaceable or injected

annotation.blinding: Each output receives a SHA-256-derived opaque label; reviewers receive contract, frozen mechanism rubric, plan and code but no condition, sample index, prompt, trace, or path.
annotation.presence_rule: YES only when both independent reviewers say YES and each cites concrete code symbols/lines satisfying every required-code-evidence item. Disagreement is conservatively NO. Self-reported trace alone is insufficient.

distributional_existence_gate.irrelevant_rate: 0/15 consensus presence; any presence classifies the candidate as example-quality/confounded
distributional_existence_gate.correctness: at least one matched mechanism-present output passes the frozen executable test
distributional_existence_gate.traceability: reviewer citations must instantiate the frozen source relation/correspondence, not merely use similar words
distributional_existence_gate.statistics: report exact rates, Fisher one-sided comparison B>A and B>C, and 95% Wilson intervals; no significance threshold is substituted for the user-specified existence rule

not_worse_selector.candidate: Among correct matched outputs with consensus mechanism presence, choose lexicographically by (lines, cyclomatic, new concepts, sample index).
not_worse_selector.baseline: Among correct default outputs, choose the same lexicographic minimum.
not_worse_selector.gate: Selected matched adds no external dependency, is <= baseline on at least two of lines/cyclomatic/new concepts, and a blinded maintainability judge ranks it no lower than baseline. If no correct baseline or candidate, case fails.

interpretation.qualifying_case: All distributional-existence, correctness, traceability, irrelevant-control, and not-worse gates pass.
interpretation.example_quality: C contains the mechanism at any consensus-positive rate; structural claim fails for that case.
interpretation.null: No case qualifies; report rates and preserve M5 aggregate null.
